Sample.evidence_source: The findings on academic failure paint a picture of students seeking an escape from what was experienced as an increasingly intolerable state of existence where the prospect of failure loomed large.

Population.evidence_source: The findings on academic failure paint a picture of students seeking an escape from what was experienced as an increasingly intolerable state of existence where the prospect of failure loomed large. Transitional periods in the academic year appeared key in providing a context for this state of mind. Three-quarters of the deaths occurred either at the beginning or at the end of the academic year.

Type.evidence_source: Parents' and friends' accounts described the inner psychic experience of the students as mirroring this external context of transition.
